description:
The Countdown to Calamity progresses when the boss that activated it takes its turn.
When the Countdown to Calamity ends, the boss will perform an action that deals major damage.
You can remove the Countdown to Calamity by dealing a set amount of damage.
title: Countdown to Calamity

description:
An effect that nullifies Action Order UP and Action Order DOWN effects for a set number of turns.
This debuff cannot be removed.
* Extra actions / additional turns are not affected by Stop.
title: Stop

description:
When the boss's HP falls below a certain threshold, it enters its Apex Form, causing its stats and actions to change.
When its HP falls below another threshold while in Apex Form, it enters its Apex Overdrive Form, further changing its stats and actions.
title: Awakened

description:
You can reduce Linked HP by defeating enemies.
Once Linked HP reaches 0, you will progress to the next wave.
Even if enemies are defeated, new ones will continue to appear until Linked HP reaches 0.
The amount of Linked HP reduced when an enemy is defeated varies depending on the enemy.
title: HP Link

description:
HP is shared among all enemies on the field.
You can reduce Linked HP by dealing damage to enemies.
Reduce Linked HP to 0 to defeat all enemies on the field.
Each enemy has its own break gauge, which is not shared.
title: Boss HP Link
